title: Energy well delivery bundle
description: Independent well planning with drilling and completion evidence.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: energy-well-delivery
  title: Energy well delivery bundle
  description: Independent well planning with drilling and completion evidence.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-08
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/energy
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [well.well_name, well.api_well_number, well.total_depth, operator.operator_name]
      relationshipIds: [operated_by]
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/daily_drilling_report, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/energy/well_completion_report, role: supporting }
